scheme_name: Mahila Samridhi Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
description:
The Mahila Samridhi Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC) in Haryana. 

This scheme was initiated in the year 2018. 

It aims to empower women from Scheduled Castes and economically weaker sections of society. 

The primary objective of the Mahila Samridhi Yojana is to promote self-employment among women. 

The scheme specifically targets women who are in need of financial assistance to start their own businesses. 

The government has set a measurable target to provide financial support to at least 10,000 women annually under this scheme. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana provides financial assistance in the form of loans. 

Eligible women can receive loans ranging from INR 50,000 to INR 1,50,000. 

The interest rate on these loans is set at a subsidized rate of 6 percent per annum. 

The repayment period for the loans is flexible and can extend up to 5 years. 

The scheme also includes a provision for skill development training. 

This training aims to enhance the entrepreneurial skills of women beneficiaries. 

The skill development programs are conducted in collaboration with various training institutes. 

These institutes are recognized by the government and have a proven track record. 

To be eligible for the Mahila Samridhi Yojana, applicants must be women belonging to Scheduled Castes. 

Additionally, applicants should be between the ages of 18 and 55 years. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at INR 3 lakh per annum for the family. 

Educational qualifications are not a strict requirement for this scheme. 

However, basic literacy is encouraged to ensure effective participation in the programs. 

The application process for the Mahila Samridhi Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested women must fill out an application form available at designated government offices. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official NSKFDC website. 

Along with the application form, applicants must submit specific documents. 

These documents include a copy of the Aadhar card for identity verification. 

Proof of Scheduled Caste certificate is also required. 

Additionally, applicants must provide income proof such as an income certificate or pay slip. 

A passport-sized photograph is also needed to complete the application. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The review process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

If approved, the loan amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The disbursement is usually done in a single installment. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana operates on a continuous basis. 

There are no specific deadlines for application submission. 

However, beneficiaries are encouraged to apply as soon as they meet the eligibility criteria. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation. 

The NSKFDC operates under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the NSKFDC helpline at 1800 180 1111. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana has seen a positive response since its inception. 

Reports indicate that over 5,000 women have benefited from the scheme in its first two years. 

The scheme has contributed to the economic upliftment of women in Haryana. 

It has also led to the establishment of numerous small businesses across the state. 

The government aims to increase the outreach of the scheme in the coming years. 

Efforts are being made to include more women from rural areas. 

Awareness campaigns are being conducted to inform potential beneficiaries. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana is part of a broader initiative to empower women in India. 

It aligns with the government's commitment to gender equality and women's rights. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in communities. 

Empowered women contribute to the overall development of their families and society. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana also encourages women to become financially independent. 

This independence is crucial for enhancing their social status. 

The scheme has provisions for monitoring and evaluation. 

Regular assessments are conducted to measure the impact of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the program. 

The government is committed to making necessary adjustments based on this feedback. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana is a significant step towards achieving socio-economic equality. 

It provides a platform for women to showcase their entrepreneurial skills. 

The scheme fosters a supportive environment for women entrepreneurs. 

By providing financial assistance and training, it reduces barriers to entry. 

Women are encouraged to participate actively in the economic landscape. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana is a testament to the government's focus on inclusive growth. 

It highlights the importance of women's contributions to the economy. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing economic conditions. 

Future enhancements may include increased loan amounts or expanded training programs. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana serves as a model for similar initiatives across the country. 

It exemplifies how targeted support can lead to meaningful change. 

Overall, the Mahila Samridhi Yojana under NSKFDC is a comprehensive welfare scheme. 

It addresses multiple facets of women's empowerment and economic development. 

The scheme is a crucial part of Haryana's efforts to uplift marginalized communities. 

It reflects a commitment to creating a more equitable society. 

Women beneficiaries are encouraged to take full advantage of this opportunity. 

The Mahila Samridhi Yojana is a pathway to self-sufficiency and success for many women in Haryana.
